required_stages.description: Single element-wise pass: read x and the INPUT mask x_keep, apply the mask (multiply or select) and the factor 1/(1-p) in fp32, round once to x's dtype, store into a freshly allocated output. No RNG, no intermediate.

forbidden_substitutions.message: library dropout replaces the whole computation and ignores the supplied mask
random number generation: the mask is an input, run() must be deterministic
host-side tensor arithmetic performs the masked rescale
mask repacking / extra buffer; only the output allocation is permitted

required_evidence.message: the supplied keep mask is consumed
fp32 arithmetic before the single rounding

outputs.aliasing: none; a freshly allocated tensor with x's shape and dtype on every call

timing_boundary.notes: The timed run() contains only the output allocation, the host scalar 1/(1-p) and one launch. The mask is a pre-generated input: no RNG, no mask transformation, no copies, no state across calls.
